fields.name: ESM message container IEI
fields.description: Information Element Identifier for ESM message container

fields.name: Length of ESM message container contents
ESM message container contents
fields.description: Contains the ESM message container contents

notes: The ESM message container is a type 6 information element
The purpose is to enable piggybacked transfer of a single ESM message within an EMM message
The ESM message included shall be coded as specified in clause 8.3, i.e. without NAS security header
